fiction: The flights are fictional. No airline, schedule, procedure or traffic data of either airport is used.

coordinates.system: scene coordinates = local SWEREF 99 TM (EPSG:3006): (SWEREF 99 TM - origin) / (25 * 0.9996584126); X east, Z south, Y up; 1 unit = 25 m; vertical RH2000 minus the vertical origin of src/lib/terrain.ts
coordinates.conversion: none in this phase: runway, taxiway and building points are read as the importer wrote them
coordinates.levels: cruise and approach levels are scene Y (above the vertical origin), not height above ground

sources.title: OpenStreetMap: runways, taxiways and building footprints
sources.accuracy: not stated by the source; volunteer mapping from aerial imagery, typically a few metres; no survey
sources.used: runway lines and widths of ESSP and F13; taxiway ways 101516378 (ESSP), 104336417 and 104336403 (F13); building footprints for the clearance check

sources.title: Markhöjdmodell Nedladdning, Lantmäteriet (processed)
sources.used: height of an aircraft on the ground (terrain + 0.25 m, as the single shuttle)

derived.deterministic: two runs gave the same SHA-256

estimates.note: Constants at the top of the backend file internal/sim/airtraffic.go; scene units (25 m) and seconds. None is a measured procedure of either airport.

loops.why: the mapped one-way circuit at each take-off threshold; at F13 the ways that keep clear of the mapped buildings (way 104336414 runs through two)

notData: No municipal, airport-operator or LFV data, no AIP procedures, no ADS-B or other traffic feed, no schedule. Aircraft ids NK-01 to NK-06 are invented.
